story.title: US lawmakers introduce bill mandating first comprehensive State Department assessment of China's AI capabilities
story.summary: US lawmakers have unveiled a draft bill that would, for the first time, legally require the State Department to deliver a detailed assessment of China's AI development to Congress, including identifying specific Chinese AI leaders and benchmarking China's progress against independent public metrics. The bill reflects escalating concern in Washington about the pace of Chinese AI advancement and the lack of structured intelligence on the topic feeding into policymaking. If passed, the resulting report would become a key document shaping US AI export controls, investment restrictions, and diplomatic strategy toward Beijing.
